notes.title: First Demo Update
notes.content: [p]In the first Official Update you can expect the following:[/p][list][*][p]More Objectives to direct you so you have specific goals to complete[/p][/*][*][p]Outline items to be easily distinguishable in the darkness[/p][/*][*][p]Beer mechanics! Cause who doesn't like beer (Careful as its permanent!)[/p][/*][*][p]Extra Puzzle: Padlock with numbers[/p][/*][*][p]More Audio diversity[/p][/*][*][p]Minor Bug Fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Before entering the game I advice to try out your microphone in the Main Menu > Options > Test Mic.[/p][p]You can also select your microphone from the button above[/p][p]If you have any problems then you might have to make the microphone you want, the default microphone in your computer.[/p]
